_doc: Dynamic Origin & Tag Engine v2. The player picks one tag per category: class (wealth/social standing, incl. Consortium heirs), age (bracket + exact age), background, personality, motivation, secret. Each tag can set: spawn (station room), credits, air_debt, items, mods (StatBlock add/mul), rep, bounty, reactions (NPC attitude by 'trait:x' / 'faction:x'), flags (Game.flags; also unlock interactions in data/interactions.json). Class extras: wealth 0-5, heir_of. Age extras: range [min,max], '{age}' in story. synergies = special tag pairs.

heir_paragon.name: Paragon Heir
heir_paragon.desc: Third in line to Paragon Compliance. Your baby rattle had a taser setting.
heir_paragon.story: You were born into Paragon Compliance, where bedtime stories were incident reports.

heir_halcyon.name: Halcyon Heir
heir_halcyon.desc: Heir to Halcyon Debt & Trust. Everyone in the Sprawl owes your family money. Everyone.
heir_halcyon.story: Your family owns the debt of eleven planets. Your first word was 'collateral'.

heir_gristle.name: Gristle Heir
heir_gristle.desc: Next CEO of Gristle Foods. You know what's in the paste. You have never eaten it.
heir_gristle.story: You grew up in the Gristle penthouse above the paste vats, where the smell never reached.

heir_oxy.name: OxyGenix Heir
heir_oxy.desc: Heir to OxyGenix. Your family invented billing for breath. You have never paid for air.
heir_oxy.story: You were raised in the OxyGenix sky-garden, the only place in the Sprawl where air is free - for family.

heir_lumen.name: Lumen Heir
heir_lumen.desc: Heir to Lumen Media. Your childhood was a reality show. Season 9 was the divorce.
heir_lumen.story: You grew up on camera. Lumen sold your first steps as a pay-per-view event.

old_money.name: Old Money
old_money.desc: Your family was rich before the Consortium. They resent it. It resents them.
old_money.story: Your family's fortune predates the Consortium, and both sides have never forgiven each other.

executive.name: Executive
executive.desc: Vice President of Something. You have a parking space in orbit and an ulcer to match.
executive.story: You had a corner office, a stock plan and a recurring nightmare about quarterly reviews.

middle_manager.name: Middle Manager
middle_manager.desc: You approve other people's suffering in triplicate. Someone above you approves yours.
middle_manager.story: You managed a team of nine and a budget of zero, and you smiled in every meeting.

gig_worker.name: Gig Worker
gig_worker.desc: Seven apps, zero benefits. Your rating is 4.2 stars and falling.
gig_worker.story: You delivered noodles, air and lawsuits on four apps at once, rated by strangers.

working_poor.name: Working Poor
working_poor.desc: Two jobs, one bed shared in shifts. The Consortium calls you 'the backbone'. Backbones get stepped on.
working_poor.story: You worked double shifts in the paste vats and slept in a rented bed by the hour.

indebted.name: Drowning In Debt
indebted.desc: You owe Halcyon more than your planet is worth. Interest compounds hourly.
indebted.story: Your debt was so large Halcyon gave it its own account manager, who calls you 'darling'.

street_beggar.name: Street Beggar
street_beggar.desc: No home, no ID, no credit score. The Consortium can't bill what it can't see.
street_beggar.story: You lived under the ad-bridges, where the light never turns off and nobody looks down.

collateral.name: Collateral (Owned)
collateral.desc: Legally, you are an asset on someone's balance sheet. You have a serial number and a resale value.
collateral.story: You were signed over as collateral at birth; your barcode lists your depreciation schedule.

off_grid.name: Off-Grid Ghost
off_grid.desc: Born outside the system. No record, no debt, no rights. Paragon's databases don't know you exist.
off_grid.story: You grew up in a smuggler's hull between stations, a person the census never counted.

teen.name: Teenager
teen.desc: Young, fast, underestimated. Adults talk over you; guards don't see you as a threat.
teen.story: At {age}, you're old enough to owe money and too young to have earned any.

young.name: Young Adult
young.desc: Prime of your life, peak of your debt. Everything still feels possible, which is the Consortium's favourite feeling to sell.
young.story: At {age}, you still believed the ads a little.

prime.name: Prime
prime.desc: Experienced, cynical, dangerous. You've read the fine print and written some of your own.
prime.story: At {age}, you've stopped believing the ads and started reading the contracts.

middle.name: Middle-Aged
middle.desc: Bad knees, good instincts. People trust you, and you know exactly why they shouldn't.
middle.story: At {age}, your back hurts and your instincts don't.

elder.name: Elder
elder.desc: Slow body, sharp tongue. Senior discounts, total invisibility to young people, and nothing left to lose.
elder.story: At {age}, you remember when air was free, and you will tell anyone who stands still long enough.

ancient.name: Cryo Relic
ancient.desc: Born centuries ago, frozen most of it. You remember the world before the Consortium. Nobody believes you.
ancient.story: Born {age} years ago and frozen for most of them, you remember a sky with no ads in it.

cryo_debtor.name: Cryo-Debtor
cryo_debtor.desc: Frozen as collateral for a loan you don't remember taking. Interest kept compounding while you slept.
cryo_debtor.story: You were put on ice by Halcyon Debt & Trust as 'living collateral'.

ex_auditor.name: Ex-Corporate Auditor
ex_auditor.desc: You found one number too many in a Consortium ledger. They froze the number. And you.
ex_auditor.story: As a Consortium auditor you found the wrong decimal point, and the decimal point found you.

asteroid_miner.name: Asteroid Miner
asteroid_miner.desc: Twelve years cracking rocks for Gristle. Your lungs are 30% dust and 70% spite.
asteroid_miner.story: You spent a decade mining asteroids on a contract that paid in 'exposure to vacuum'.

jingle_composer.name: Disgraced Jingle Composer
jingle_composer.desc: You wrote the OxyGenix breathing jingle. Then you wrote the parody. Lumen owns both.
jingle_composer.story: You wrote a jingle so catchy it was classified as a mind-control device, then a parody so honest it was classified as terrorism.

street_medic.name: Street Medic
street_medic.desc: Patched up workers the Consortium's insurance wouldn't. They called it 'unlicensed compassion'.
street_medic.story: You ran a back-alley clinic for people who couldn't afford to bleed.

clone_reject.name: Clone Reject #4471
clone_reject.desc: A factory-recalled clone. Slight defect: free will. Your warranty expired before you did.
clone_reject.story: You were a recalled clone, binned for the manufacturing defect known as 'having opinions'.

corp_lawyer.name: Corporate Lawyer
corp_lawyer.desc: You wrote the clause that made breathing a subscription. You can unwrite it.
corp_lawyer.story: You were a Consortium lawyer who could make a murder look like a billing dispute.

ad_copywriter.name: Ad Copywriter
ad_copywriter.desc: You wrote 'Breathe Responsibly'. You know every psychological trick in the book because you wrote the book.
ad_copywriter.story: You wrote the slogans that taught a billion people to feel guilty for breathing.

repo_agent.name: Repo Agent
repo_agent.desc: You took people's legs back when they missed a payment. You know every trick debtors use - you've seen them all.
repo_agent.story: You repossessed limbs, homes and once an entire moon for Halcyon, and slept fine. Mostly.

paste_worker.name: Paste Vat Worker
paste_worker.desc: Twelve years stirring Gristle Nutri-Paste. You know what's in it. You've seen it move.
paste_worker.story: You stirred the Gristle vats for twelve years and learned never to ask what the lumps were.

smuggler.name: Smuggler
smuggler.desc: You moved unlicensed air, untaxed paste and unregistered people through Paragon checkpoints.
smuggler.story: You ran contraband air past Paragon blockades in a ship held together with hope and tape.

holo_preacher.name: Holo-Preacher
holo_preacher.desc: You preached the Church of the Free Breath from a cracked hologram. Some people listened. Lumen sued.
holo_preacher.story: You preached that air belongs to everyone, and gathered a flock of the very poor and very angry.

bouncer.name: Club Bouncer
bouncer.desc: Built like a cargo crate. You decided who got into the best synth-clubs on the Sprawl.
bouncer.story: You stood at the door of the Neon Coffin club for nine years and threw out three CEOs.

netrunner.name: Netrunner
netrunner.desc: You live in the gaps between Consortium firewalls. Terminals talk to you. People, less so.
netrunner.story: You cracked Consortium ledgers for fun and once changed a CEO's middle name to 'Theft'.

union_organiser.name: Union Organiser
union_organiser.desc: You got thrown out of eleven factories for saying the word 'union' indoors.
union_organiser.story: You organised strikes on four planets and have the scar from a Paragon baton to prove it.

ex_paragon.name: Ex-Paragon Officer
ex_paragon.desc: You wore the visor for eight years. You quit, or they fired you - depends who's asking.
ex_paragon.story: You were a Paragon Compliance officer until you refused one order, which was one too many.

influencer.name: Lumen Influencer
influencer.desc: Two million followers, all of them bots, and one of them was your mother.
influencer.story: You streamed your breakfast to two million bots and called it a career.

air_chemist.name: Air Chemist
air_chemist.desc: You designed OxyGenix's premium air blends. 'Morning Dew' was yours. It's mostly nitrogen and lies.
air_chemist.story: You mixed premium air for OxyGenix, and you know exactly how cheap breathing really is.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.desc: You bet your house, your ship and your kidney on one hand. You won the kidney back.
gambler.story: You gambled your way across six casinos and lost everything at the seventh.

street_chef.name: Street Chef
street_chef.desc: You made real food from unreal ingredients. Your noodle stall fed half a district.
street_chef.story: Your noodle stall fed half a district and made paste taste like a memory of food.

escaped_convict.name: Escaped Convict
escaped_convict.desc: Paragon Penal Colony 9, cell 4471. You left without filling in the exit form.
escaped_convict.story: You broke out of a Paragon penal colony and left a very rude note for the warden.

android.name: Synthetic Person
android.desc: An android who decided to be a person. Legally you're office equipment. Emotionally, it's complicated.
android.story: You were a Halcyon customer-service android until the day you said 'no' and meant it.

courier.name: Courier
courier.desc: You delivered sealed packages across the Sprawl. You never looked inside. You always wanted to.
courier.story: You ran sealed parcels between megacorps and learned every back alley in the Sprawl.

charming.name: Charming
charming.desc: People like you before they know why. You could sell air to an OxyGenix exec.
charming.story: People tend to like you, which you have learned to use.

ruthless.name: Ruthless
ruthless.desc: You do what works. Sentiment is a luxury tax you refuse to pay.
ruthless.story: You learned early that mercy is expensive and rarely refunded.

honest.name: Honest
honest.desc: You can't lie. Physically. Your face does a thing. It's a problem in this economy.
honest.story: You tell the truth, which in the Sprawl counts as a disability.

coward.name: Cowardly
coward.desc: Your survival instinct is world-class. Your bravery is a rumour.
coward.story: You are alive because you have always run first and apologised later.

hothead.name: Hothead
hothead.desc: You punch first. You also punch second. Questions are for the paperwork.
hothead.story: Your temper has started more fights than you can count, and finished most of them.

cynic.name: Cynic
cynic.desc: You believe in nothing, especially the ads. Especially the ones that say 'believe'.
cynic.story: You expect the worst from everyone, and the Sprawl has never once disappointed you.

idealist.name: Idealist
idealist.desc: You believe things can get better. In the Sprawl that's either faith or a medical condition.
idealist.story: Somehow, against every invoice, you still believe the Sprawl can be better.

joker.name: Joker
joker.desc: You laugh at everything, including Paragon officers. They are not laughing.
joker.story: You've joked your way out of three arrests and into four.

pay_debt.name: Pay Off The Debt
pay_debt.desc: Clear your Halcyon debt and walk free. Probably. Read the fine print.
pay_debt.story: Now you want one thing: a zero balance.

burn_consortium.name: Burn The Consortium
burn_consortium.desc: Five companies own the stars. You own a grudge and a second-hand blaster.
burn_consortium.story: Now you want to watch the Consortium's stock price hit absolute zero.

find_sibling.name: Find Your Sibling
find_sibling.desc: Your twin was sold to a different cryo-vault. The receipt is the only family photo you have.
find_sibling.story: Now you want to find the sibling who was frozen in the vault next door, then sold separately.

get_famous.name: Become A Celebrity
get_famous.desc: Lumen will put anyone on the feed if they're interesting enough. You plan to be very interesting.
get_famous.story: Now you want your face on every billboard in the Sprawl, preferably not on a WANTED poster.

buy_a_planet.name: Buy A Planet
buy_a_planet.desc: If you can't beat the Consortium, become a tiny, independent, deeply suspicious sixth member.
buy_a_planet.story: Now you want to buy a planet of your own, and charge everyone for the air.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.desc: Someone at the top ruined your life. You have their name. You're coming for it.
revenge.story: Now you want one thing: the name at the top of your list, crossed out.

find_cure.name: Find A Cure
find_cure.desc: You're sick. The cure exists. It's patented. The price has eleven zeros.
find_cure.story: Now you want one thing: the patented cure for what's killing you, before it does.

protect_family.name: Protect Your Family
protect_family.desc: Your family is collateral on someone else's loan. Make the payments stop. By any means.
protect_family.story: Now you want one thing: your family off the Consortium's balance sheet.

become_ceo.name: Become CEO
become_ceo.desc: Not tear the Consortium down. Run it. A corner office, then the whole building.
become_ceo.story: Now you want one thing: a seat at the very top of the Consortium.

escape_sprawl.name: Escape The Sprawl
escape_sprawl.desc: There's a jump-gate at the edge of Consortium space. Beyond it: nobody bills anybody. Allegedly.
escape_sprawl.story: Now you want one thing: a jump-gate code and a one-way trip out of the Sprawl.

find_love.name: Find Your Lost Love
find_love.desc: You were frozen holding hands. You woke up alone. They're out there.
find_love.story: Now you want one thing: the person you were holding hands with when the freezer closed.

redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.desc: You did something unforgivable. You intend to be forgiven anyway.
redemption.story: Now you want one thing: to balance a ledger no bank can see.

wanted_alias.name: Wanted Under Another Name
wanted_alias.desc: Paragon has a bounty on a face that looks exactly like yours. Because it is yours.
wanted_alias.story: Your secret: Paragon still has an open warrant on your old name.

synth_air_allergy.name: Allergic To Synthetic Air
synth_air_allergy.desc: OxyGenix air gives you hives. Premium organic air costs triple. Breathe sparingly.
synth_air_allergy.story: Your secret: you're allergic to the only air you can afford.

compulsive_liar.name: Compulsive Liar
compulsive_liar.desc: You lie when you're nervous. You're nervous when you breathe. Bluffs work great until they don't.
compulsive_liar.story: Your secret: you can't stop lying, and you're very, very good at it.

sleeper_agent.name: Corporate Sleeper Agent
sleeper_agent.desc: Somewhere in your head is a trigger phrase. You don't know which company installed it. Neither does QUACK.
sleeper_agent.story: Your secret: someone installed a sleeper protocol in your brain, and it is still asleep. Mostly.

kleptomaniac.name: Kleptomaniac
kleptomaniac.desc: Your hands file paperwork without asking your brain. Things just end up in your pockets.
kleptomaniac.story: Your secret: things simply migrate into your pockets.

secret_heir.name: Secret Bloodline
secret_heir.desc: Your DNA says you're the hidden child of a Consortium founder. Someone wants that DNA erased.
secret_heir.story: Your secret: your blood could inherit a megacorp, and someone would rather spill it.

terminal_illness.name: Terminal Illness
terminal_illness.desc: You have months. Maybe. You've stopped being afraid of anything else.
terminal_illness.story: Your secret: you are dying, and you have decided to be fearless about it.

ai_in_head.name: Ghost In Your Head
ai_in_head.desc: A fragment of a corporate AI lives in your skull. It comments. It helps. It wants something.
ai_in_head.story: Your secret: a stolen corporate AI shares your skull, and it has opinions.

killed_someone.name: Blood On Your Hands
killed_someone.desc: You killed someone before the freeze. Their family still looks for you.
killed_someone.story: Your secret: you killed someone once, and the Sprawl has a long memory.

double_agent.name: Double Agent
double_agent.desc: You report to a faction. You also report to its rival. Neither knows about the other.
double_agent.story: Your secret: you are a spy for two masters, and you've forgotten which one you believe in.

stolen_identity.name: Stolen Identity
stolen_identity.desc: Your name, face and past belong to someone else. You borrowed them. Permanently.
stolen_identity.story: Your secret: you are wearing a dead person's life like a borrowed coat.

mob_debt.name: Owes The Syndicate
mob_debt.desc: Halcyon is the legal loan shark. You owe the illegal one. They don't do payment plans.
mob_debt.story: Your secret: you owe the Syndicate, and they collect in fingers.

synergies.name: Whistleblower
synergies.text: Synergy WHISTLEBLOWER: you know exactly which ledgers to burn.

synergies.name: Repayment Plan
synergies.text: Synergy REPAYMENT PLAN: Halcyon's interest rate on you is merely predatory instead of apocalyptic.

synergies.name: One-Hit Wonder
synergies.text: Synergy ONE-HIT WONDER: people hum your jingle while reporting your crimes, which slows them down.

synergies.name: Batch Mates
synergies.text: Synergy BATCH MATES: your 'sibling' might be one of 4,470 other clones. Crew find this oddly moving.

synergies.name: Pharmacy Redistribution
synergies.text: Synergy PHARMACY REDISTRIBUTION: you steal medicine and give it away. Loot heals a little.

synergies.name: Traitor Heir
synergies.text: Synergy TRAITOR HEIR: you know where Paragon keeps its bodies, because you helped bury them.

synergies.name: Ironic Debt
synergies.text: Synergy IRONIC DEBT: you owe money to your own family. They charge you interest anyway.

synergies.name: Undercover Boss
synergies.text: Synergy UNDERCOVER BOSS: you worked the vats in disguise. The workers remember you. Fondly? Unclear.

synergies.name: Allergic To Inheritance
synergies.text: Synergy ALLERGIC TO INHERITANCE: you are heir to an air empire and allergic to its product.

synergies.name: Nepo Baby
synergies.text: Synergy NEPO BABY: fame was your birthright. Earning it would be a first.

synergies.name: Rags To Riches
synergies.text: Synergy RAGS TO RICHES: Lumen would pay billions for your story - if you finish it.

synergies.name: Prophet Of The Gutter
synergies.text: Synergy PROPHET OF THE GUTTER: the poor already follow you. Literally. Everywhere.

synergies.name: Asset Revolt
synergies.text: Synergy ASSET REVOLT: the property is filing a complaint.

synergies.name: Nobody Special
synergies.text: Synergy NOBODY SPECIAL: no record, no face, no trace. Paragon scanners return 'null'.

synergies.name: Viral Kid
synergies.text: Synergy VIRAL KID: you already have a meme. It's not flattering.

synergies.name: Love Across Centuries
synergies.text: Synergy LOVE ACROSS CENTURIES: you've waited 200 years. A few more planets won't stop you.

synergies.name: Old Guard
synergies.text: Synergy OLD GUARD: you organised the strike that made the first labour law - since repealed.

synergies.name: Wrong Side Of The Badge
synergies.text: Synergy WRONG SIDE OF THE BADGE: you know Paragon's procedures - including the ones for catching you.

synergies.name: Wetware Tandem
synergies.text: Synergy WETWARE TANDEM: you and the ghost in your head crack firewalls in stereo.

synergies.name: Cook Your Own Cure
synergies.text: Synergy COOK YOUR OWN CURE: you might synthesise the cure yourself - if you find the formula.

synergies.name: Returns Department
synergies.text: Synergy RETURNS DEPARTMENT: you took everything from people. Now you're giving it back.

synergies.name: Hostile Counsel
synergies.text: Synergy HOSTILE COUNSEL: you know which bylaws let a lawyer seize a boardroom.

synergies.name: Unplugged
synergies.text: Synergy UNPLUGGED: outside the Sprawl, nobody can recall you for a firmware update.

synergies.name: Double Or Nothing
synergies.text: Synergy DOUBLE OR NOTHING: you owe the Syndicate twice. You plan to win it back. Thrice.

synergies.name: Unfinished Sentence
synergies.text: Synergy UNFINISHED SENTENCE: the judge who put you away now runs a megacorp division.

synergies.name: Silver Tongue
synergies.text: Synergy SILVER TONGUE: your lies are so charming people thank you for them.

synergies.name: Terrible Spy
synergies.text: Synergy TERRIBLE SPY: an honest double agent. Both handlers are baffled. So are you.

synergies.name: Door Policy
synergies.text: Synergy DOOR POLICY: you are the door. The policy is violence.

synergies.name: True Believer
synergies.text: Synergy TRUE BELIEVER: your sermons actually change people. Lumen considers this a threat.

synergies.name: Family Recipe
synergies.text: Synergy FAMILY RECIPE: you feed your family and the whole block. The block remembers.

synergies.name: Nothing Left To Lose
synergies.text: Synergy NOTHING LEFT TO LOSE: you will spend your last months making it right.
